title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, agent/tool-calling example apps, and quickstart documentation to make it easier for developers to onboard RAG+agent patterns on Redwood. Motivation: teams repeatedly ask for copy-pasteable examples that combine Redwood's streaming + tool-calling features with a document retriever and a simple fallback policy. What I changed: 1) redwood-examples/rag-agent/ - three small example apps (python and typescript) demonstrating: a) RAG pipeline with embedding-based retrieval and KV cache warming, b) an agent that calls an external weather API and a search tool via tool-calling, and c) an end-to-end test harness used by the docs; 2) redwood-docs/docs/guides/rag-agent-quickstart.md - a quickstart guide with step-by-step instructions, code snippets, and a troubleshooting section; 3) redwood-docs/static/playground/rag-agent-template.json - two template configs for Hosted and Dedicated modes showing batching and quantization hints; 4) redwood-examples/ci/integration/rag-agent-e2e.yml - lightweight CI to run the example harness. Testing: included unit tests for the example retriever and ran the docs site local build. Rollout: docs changes are gated behind the docs site build; examples are under the redwood-examples subdir. Related: links to ENG-1034 and PM-211. No breaking API changes.

Maya Patel: Increased timeout and added a small retry loop for the mock tool; re-ran CI and it passed.
Samir Gupta: Left a minor nit on the template config comments. Otherwise LGTM.

release_notes: Added RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples (Python & TypeScript), integration CI for examples, and a docs quickstart covering KV cache, batching, and cost guidance.
